title: 낙동강수계관리위원회규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:19463:20060428:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Agricultural Infrastructure Corporation and Farmland Management Fund Act) <Presidential Decree No. 19463, April 28, 2006>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on April 30, 2006.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (16) Omitted.
(17) Part of the Regulations on the Nakdong River Basin Management Committee shall be amended as follows:
In Article 6 (3) 4, "Agricultural Infrastructure Corporation" shall be replaced with "Korea Rural Community Corporation."
(18) through (41) Omitted.
Article 3 Omitted.
